items.content: What's the most severe XSS finding from this scan?

The highest-severity XSS findings are the dalfox-detected reflected XSS on http://localhost:4280/vulnerabilities/xss_r/?name=... and the xsstrike confirmation of the same sink with a polyglot payload (severity: high). Both target the DVWA reflected-XSS lab; remediation requires HTML body context output encoding.

Yes. xsstrike found a stored XSS in php-goof's post.php comment field (param=comment, payload=<details/open/ontoggle=alert(1)>) at severity medium. The sink reflects untrusted comment data into the post detail HTML body without escaping. Recommend applying htmlspecialchars($comment, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8') before output.
